```{r}
#| code-summary: "Libraries"

library("tidyverse")
library("arrow")
library("geoarrow")
library("sf")
```

# CCUH Aim 2 Data Sets

Below is code to retrieve the CCUH Aim 2 data from the CCUH database.

## Mortality
[CCUH Aim 2 Mortality Data Access](https://www.notion.so/drexel-ccuh/CCUH-Aim-2-Mortality-Harmonized-Datasets-1a457008e885803ca9e5cd2997558357)

```{r}
#| eval: false

# Read data from data base
df_aim2_schema = "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/v_0_1_0/base__ccuh__aim2_city_subcity_nbhd__schema.parquet" %>% 
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  collect()
  
df_aim2_mort =  "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/v_0_1_0/harmonized__ccuh_aim_2__death_records.parquet" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() 
  
df_aim2_nbhd_deaths =  "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/v_0_1_0/harmonized__ccuh_aim_2__nbhd_death_counts.parquet" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() 
  
df_aim2_nbhd_deaths_age =  "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/v_0_1_0/harmonized__ccuh_aim_2__nbhd_death_counts__age_grp_65.parquet" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() 
```

## Temperature

[CCUH Aim 2 Temperature Data Acess](https://www.notion.so/drexel-ccuh/CCUH-Aim-2-City-level-Daily-Temperature-Harmonized-Datasets-harmonized__ccuh_aim_2__city_level_da-1a557008e885800e8b91eabd249d798c)

```{r}
#| eval: false

# Read data from data base
df_aim2_city_daily_temp = "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/v_0_1_0/harmonized__ccuh_aim_2__city_level_daily_temperature.parquet" |> 
   arrow::open_dataset()  |>
   dplyr::collect()
```

# Fully Merged Data

[Final Data Bundle](https://www.notion.so/drexel-ccuh/CCUH-MS1-Data-Bundle-v1-ms1__final_bundle__v1-1a857008e885806f84f1fa3166db8f42)

```{r}
#| eval: true 

# Read data from data base
df_schema =  "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/v_0_1_0/base__ccuh__aim2_city_subcity_nbhd__schema.parquet" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() |> 
  dplyr::collect()
  
df_data = "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/v_0_1_0/ccuh_ms1__final_bundle__v1.parquet" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() |> 
  dplyr::collect()

df_data_age = "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/v_0_1_0/ccuh_ms1__final_bundle_age__v1.parquet" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() |>  
  dplyr::collect()

# Save data locally
write_csv(df_data, "merged_data.csv")
write_csv(df_data_age, "merged_data_by_age.csv")
```
